scenes.title: Situation A — Staff hands items to Security
Situation B — Security hands items to CBTO
Wrong details and the signed copy

lines.text: There are two situations.
In Situation A, you hand items to Security.
In Situation B, Security hands items to CBTO.
Security fills in the form and brings the phone in both situations.
First, check who is receiving the items.
If you are handing items to Security, Security signs first as the recipient.
Then it is your turn.
Check your name, your role, and the items listed.
If everything is correct, sign with your finger and tap ‘Confirm’.
Tap ‘Clear’ if you need to sign again.
Next, the witness checks their own name, signs, and taps ‘Confirm’.
The witness gives the phone back to Security.
If Security hands items to CBTO, the CBTO staff member signs first as the recipient.
If that is you, check your name.
Scroll up and check each item you received.
Sign with your finger and tap ‘Confirm’.
Pass the phone back to Security.
Security signs as ‘Handed over by’.
The witness checks their own name, signs, taps ‘Confirm’, and gives the phone back to Security.
If a name, role, or item is wrong, tell Security before signing.
Each person signs for themselves.
After everyone has signed, Security saves the record.
The app creates a signed PDF with a Record ID.
AirAsia Security keeps it in a restricted folder and logs the record.
Security emails you a copy for your records.
